§3.5 Output Options

📚 Document rule — needs other pages of the document; decided once and applied on every page

output-output-options · output output-model options

❓ Open point

Four situations have more than one conforming output, depending on what the producer was asked to produce. Working default: the narrower reading — fragments separate, graphics described, everything printed recorded — which conforms under either setting. Proposed resolution: make each an explicit, named option of the request, and judge the output under the options it was produced with.

Every other requirement holds whatever the producer was configured to do. These four do not: an output that assumes a setting the producer did not use is not held to a stricter standard; it is held to an unreachable one.

The four options

The page shows With the option Without it (working default)
A printed folio The number is also recorded on its own, per page It survives only inside the band text
A logo, seal or icon The mark MAY be referenced as a saved image Its content MUST be put into the text stream — see Images§12.1.1
A table continuing overleaf The fragments MAY be joined into one table Each fragment MUST stand alone — see Cross-Page Tables§4.3
A table titled (continued) As above The marker is kept and the fragment stands alone — see Continued in the Title§9.2.3

Why the narrower reading is the default

Nothing in the narrower reading is wrong under the wider setting; it is only less than the wider setting allows. The reverse is not true: an output that fuses two fragments cannot be split into two again if the setting turns out to be off.
